entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I start with your name and the order number, please?
Of course. It's David Miller, order number VF789012.
Thank you, David. I have your account pulled up. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... we've had a family emergency. My son was scheduled for a military deployment, but right before he was supposed to leave, he had to have emergency surgery. He's been in the hospital for weeks, and I've been there with him. I haven't even had a moment to think about this device. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back.
David, I am so incredibly sorry to hear about your son. I hope he's having a swift recovery. Please, don't worry about the return. Let me just check the purchase date here for you.
Thank you. I appreciate that. I just feel awful I let it sit for so long.

Not at all, it's completely understandable. Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 23 days ago. Let me just consult our policy... and yes, that's perfectly fine. According to our system, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, really? I thought I had missed it for sure. That's... that's wonderful news. Oh, thank you.

You're very welcome. There was no need to worry. I am processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Sarah, you've been a huge help. This is such a relief. Thank you so, so much.
It's my pleasure, David. I'm glad I could make things a little easier for you today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Thank you again, and I hope you have a good day.
You too, David. All the best to your son. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
